assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness that are intermittent and difficult to capture on standard ambulatory monitoring.
The patient has a history of paroxysmal atrial fibrillation (I48.0).
The patient has a history of supraventricular tachycardia (I47.1).
Long-term continuous ECG monitoring (CPT 93247) is indicated to correlate these symptoms with arrhythmic events and guide further management.
The service supports the medical necessity of the denied service.
The denied service is for CPT code 93247.
The denial is based on Reason Code CO-197 indicating that the required precertification or prior authorization was not obtained before the service was rendered.
